coordinateSystem: Top-left pixel centers of the complete original photograph; u=(x+0.5)/width, v=(y+0.5)/height. No crop offset. Runtime cover mapping uses decoded derivative dimensions.

algorithm.reusedMeasurement: scripts/extract-hero-stars.py: measure_star and luminance helpers only; no old-photo masks/main
algorithm.detection: 2048px Lanczos proxy; strict 5x5 local maxima; sigma=3px local contrast

selection.method: Round-robin strongest remaining candidate by grid cell

exclusions.rationale: Only the upper 52 percent is measured; lower trees, cars, horizon and ground excluded.

algorithm.photometry: Measured original-resolution centroids and sRGB samples; no arbitrary star positions; existing strength mapping retained
